erplibre_mobile_chat.description: ERPLibre companion module — 1.0 adds erplibre_client_uuid to mail.message so a chat post sent twice is stored once; 1.1 adds it to discuss.channel so create_group and channel_create called twice with the same uuid by the same user make one conversation (advisory lock plus partial unique indexes), and the administrator-only erplibre_remove_member; 1.2 adds erplibre_client_uuid to ir.attachment and the route /erplibre_mobile_chat/attachment/upload (CSRF required, internal users only), which makes an attachment upload idempotent by client_uuid and keeps the original of an image; 1.3 adds erplibre_body_fingerprint to mail.message (the sha256 of the body) and the route /erplibre_mobile_chat/message/update_content, an edit that writes only when the message still has the body the app read (internal users only), and answers erplibre_conflict otherwise; 1.4 adds the route /erplibre_mobile_chat/message/search (a read-only search of the messages of the channels the user is a member of, by body, subject and attachment name, paged, with a count), erplibre_set_starred on mail.message (sets the starred state instead of toggling it, so a replay changes nothing), the erplibre_client_uuid dedup of a post on every mail.thread model (a reply in a record's chatter sent twice is stored once), the upload route open to the record threads of mail.thread models, and the field erplibre_chat_level on mail.message, a computed Selection whose last key is the module level, readable by any internal user through fields_get, which the app reads to tell the level. Optional: without it the app falls back to the marker comment in the message body and to a fingerprint search for a lost create, and cannot remove a member, and the upload of a file goes to Odoo's route, found again by search after a lost answer; without 1.3 the app re-reads the message just before an edit and refuses it if it changed; without 1.4 the app searches with search_read on mail.message restricted to the member channels it reads fresh, re-reads the starred state before every toggle and sends it only if it differs, finds a lost reply on a record by the marker comment, and sends the files of a reply to Odoo's route; a server older than 1.4 is offered the upgrade
